title: llama.cpp inference
description: Run llama.cpp inference using serverless RunPod workers!

input.name: Command line arguments for llama-server
input.description: Launch argv for llama-server. Do not define --port. If cached model mode is enabled, do not define -hf or -m here. If using mmproj env fields, do not define --mmproj here.

input.name: Hugging Face Hub model name for cached model
input.description: Hugging Face Hub model name to use for the cached GGUF model. Leave empty to disable caching. Example: user/model-name

input.name: Path to GGUF file in the Hugging Face Hub model repository
input.description: Path to the GGUF file in the Hugging Face Hub model repository to use for caching. Example: model.gguf

input.name: Path to mmproj file in the same Hugging Face Hub repository
input.description: Optional cached multimodal projector path. Use when the mmproj file is in the same cached Hugging Face repository as LLAMA_CACHED_MODEL.

input.name: Local path to mmproj file
input.description: Optional local or network-volume path to a multimodal projector file. Do not combine with LLAMA_CACHED_MMPROJ_PATH or LLAMA_MMPROJ_URL.

input.name: URL to mmproj file
input.description: Optional URL for llama-server --mmproj-url. Useful when RunPod cached model mode only caches the main GGUF.

input.name: Default OpenAI model id
input.description: Optional model id used by the worker when a request omits model. Leave empty to read the first model from llama-server.

input.name: Local OpenAI base URL
input.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL used by the worker to call the local llama-server.

input.name: Local OpenAI API key
input.description: API key for the local OpenAI client. llama-server does not require one by default.

input.name: llama-server bind host
input.description: Host passed to llama-server when LLAMA_SERVER_CMD_ARGS does not define --host.

input.name: RunPod Hugging Face cache directory
input.description: Directory containing RunPod cached Hugging Face hub snapshots.

input.name: llama-server startup timeout seconds
input.description: How long the worker waits for llama-server to print that it is listening before failing startup.

input.name: Maximum Concurrency
input.description: Maximum number of concurrent requests to handle. Use 1 for large single-slot llama.cpp models unless --parallel is intentionally increased.

input.name: RunPod handler mode
input.description: Use one-shot for normal non-streaming responses. Use stream to enable RunPod aggregate streaming.
